name: Deep End — Shifting (Maintaining the Touch)
summary: Charlotte's approach: straddle a partner, hand-held toy, or insertable, then rock the body gently while keeping continuous contact with the deep end—massaging without breaking connection or thumping in and out.
detailed_description: Shifting keeps the connection unbroken. From a straddling position over a partner, a hand-held toy, or an insertable device, rock the body gently so the deep end is massaged through continuous pressure rather than repeated re-entry. Continuous contact builds a pleasure wave, whereas thumping or bumping in and out tends to create pain on the sensitive zone.
stepwise_structure: 1. Straddle the partner, hand-held toy, or insertable device.
2. Establish gentle contact with the deep end.
3. Rock the body gently while keeping that contact continuous.
4. Massage the area without breaking connection.
5. Avoid thumping or bumping in and out—keep the pressure sustained.
safety_notes: Keep contact continuous; re-entry impacts can hurt the sensitive zone.
Move slowly and adjust angle smoothly.

meta.why_it_works: Continuous pressure builds a pleasure wave rather than repetitive pain from re-entry impacts.
